description: Join a game a friend made, from this chat. Use it when the player pastes a line like "Join my Playtable game: game_id ...". It takes the next open seat for the player and shows them the board. You get a watch key: you see what anyone watching sees, never anyone's hidden cards, and the player makes their own moves on the board. Turns don't have to be at the same time.
name: join_game
title: Join a friend's game
